title: Iran adoption a strategy of 'war of attrition on several fronts'
summary: On the second week of the war in the Middle East, Iran continues to target Israel and US allies in the Gulf. More strikes have been intercepted, according to reports across several countries. Iran's targets include oil infrastructures, which is part of its "war of attrition" strategy, which applies on several fronts. FRANCE 24's Hoda Abdel-Hamid tells us mo…
